principle: Ingress and execution routing must treat platform rules as enforcement constraints subordinate to canonical JPV governance, never as a source of ownership or organizational authority.
gateway_requirements: load canonical JPV authority before platform-specific constraints
detect unsatisfiable approval or review gates before routing work into them
require a governed recovery path for any blocking platform rule
preserve security, CI, provenance, and signature evidence during recovery
reject platform configuration that has no operable satisfaction path
emit REVIEW_GATE_UNSATISFIABLE instead of assigning impossible manual work to the founder
